subcategory_text: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 9.1, Annex A.5.1, Annex A.5.19
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.OV-02, GV.OV-02.01, GV.OV-02.02
implementation_examples: Review audit findings to confirm whether the existing cybersecurity strategy has ensured compliance with internal and external requirements
Review the performance oversight of those in cybersecurity-related roles to determine whether policy changes are necessary
Review strategy in light of cybersecurity incidents
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks.
Determine whether activities are conducted to review audit findings to confirm whether the existing cybersecurity strategy has ensured compliance with internal and external requirements.
Determine whether activities are conducted to review the performance oversight of those in cybersecurity-related roles to determine whether policy changes are necessary.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
